body.name: joint high-probability event
body.construction: With every median-of-means statistic formed from the nonempty \(b_n(\beta)\)-block partition at its displayed \(\beta\), let \(E_D=\{|\widetilde\theta_D-\theta_0|\le a_D\}\), \(E_K=\bigcap_{j=1}^4\{|\widehat m_j-E_P[r^j]|\le\rho_n(\alpha/16)\}\), \(E_A=\{|\widehat H_A-\theta_0\widehat S_A-E_P[(Y-\widehat q(X)-\theta_0r)\widehat A_3(r)\mid D_K]|\le\rho_n(\alpha/4)\}\), and \(E_S=\{|\widehat S_A-E_P[r\widehat A_3(r)\mid D_K]|\le\rho_n(\alpha/4)\}\), with each conditional expectation holding \(D_K\) and the supplied fits fixed.
